entry.title: Gym Xuân Trường Sa Pa
entry.notes: Budget gym; dumbbells up to 45 kg, free weights and cardio machines. Reported day pass 50k (March 2024). 06:00–12:00, 14:00–21:00; Sunday closes 20:00. Elevator to 4th floor; bring clean gym shoes. Phone +84 912 927 756. No licensed photo verified.
